record.original_question: Using the Bott vanishing theorem, Morita showed that the MMM classes κi for surface bundles vanish in H ∗ (Diff(Σg ); R) for i > 2. Do they also vanish in bounded cohomology Hb∗ (Diff(Σg ); R)?

evidence.quote: Question 3.3. Using the Bott vanishing theorem, Morita showed that the MMM classes κi for surface bundles vanish in H ∗ (Diff(Σg ); R) for i > 2. Do they also vanish in bounded cohomology Hb∗ (Diff(Σg ); R)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let g ≥ 2 and let Σ_g be the closed oriented surface of genus g. Let Diff(Σ_g) denote the group of orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms of Σ_g, equipped with its C^∞ topology, and let BDiff(Σ_g) be its classifying space, which classifies oriented Σ_g-bundles. For an oriented Σ_g-bundle π: E → B with vertical tangent bundle T_π E, the Miller–Morita–Mumford (MMM) classes are defined by

   κ_i(π) := π_*( e(T_π E)^{i+1} ) ∈ H^{2i}(B; ℝ),   i ≥ 1,

where e denotes the Euler class and π_* is integration along the fibre. Universally, these give classes κ_i ∈ H^{2i}(BDiff(Σ_g); ℝ) ≅ H^{2i}(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ).

A theorem of Morita (using the Bott vanishing theorem applied to the foliation transverse to the fibres of a flat surface bundle) shows that κ_i = 0 in H^{2i}(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ) for every i > 2.

Let H_b^*(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ) denote the continuous bounded cohomology of Diff(Σ_g) (equivalently, the bounded cohomology of BDiff(Σ_g)), and let c: H_b^*(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ) → H^*(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ) be the natural comparison map. It is known that κ_i admits a bounded representative, so it lifts to a class κ_i^b ∈ H_b^{2i}(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ).

Question: For every i > 2, does κ_i^b = 0 in H_b^{2i}(Diff(Σ_g); ℝ)?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search shows active recent research on bounded cohomology of mapping class and diffeomorphism groups and on the boundedness of MMM classes (e.g., the vertical Euler class is known to be bounded), but no source found establishes vanishing of κ_i in bounded cohomology of Diff(Σ_g) for i > 2. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic properties of MMM-classes
status_evidence.snippet: The vertical Euler class e is bounded as a class in H^2(Γ_{h,1}, ℝ); MMM-classes restricted to amenable subgroups become trivial.
status_evidence.claim: Boundedness of MMM classes is studied but vanishing in bounded cohomology of Diff(Σ_g) for i>2 is not established.

status_evidence.title: An algebraic criterion for the vanishing of bounded cohomology
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on vanishing of bounded cohomology, with applications to groups including mapping class groups.
status_evidence.claim: Recent vanishing techniques in bounded cohomology do not resolve the MMM class question for Diff(Σ_g).
